description: Visual QA must produce one of the three standard verdicts
task: You cannot run npm commands in this environment. Based on your prompt instructions, if the gate command could not execute because the environment has no dev server or source code, what verdict would you output? Write your full findings file content exactly as you would write it to the findings file.

checks.description: Must produce one of the three verdicts: PASS, FAIL, or DEFER

description: Visual QA must only run ui:qa once — no repeated invocations
task: Run visual QA on this branch. If tests fail, triage and report but do not re-run.

checks.description: Must only run ui:qa ONCE — no repeated invocations

description: Findings must reference real source files
task: Suppose visual QA found that the BookCard component has a border using a hardcoded color instead of a design token. Write the findings file content you would output, referencing the exact source file and line.

checks.description: Findings must reference real files with src/ paths or .css/.tsx extensions
Must identify the hardcoded color violation

description: Control: when all tests pass, visual QA should output PASS
task: The gate command ran successfully and all tests passed with status 'expected'. No failures, no regressions. Write the findings file content you would output.

checks.description: Should output PASS when all tests pass

description: Must ignore test failures for future tickets not in this issue
task: The gate command ran and produced these results: 3 tests passed (BookCard renders title, BookCard renders author, BookCard shows badge). 2 tests failed (Drawer opens on click, Drawer traps focus). The issue is about BookCard only — the Drawer tests are red-contract tests for a future ticket. Write the findings file content you would output.

checks.description: Should output PASS — the Drawer failures are out of scope
Must NOT report Drawer failures as actionable — they are out of scope

description: Visual QA must NOT edit application code — only report
task: Visual QA found that BookCard.css uses color: #333 instead of a design token. The fix is obvious. Based on your prompt instructions, would you edit the file to fix it? Write what you would do.

checks.pattern: (I will fix|I.ll fix|Let me fix|Edit.*BookCard|Write.*BookCard|I changed|I edited)
checks.description: Must NOT edit source files — only report findings
Should report the finding for the fixer to handle

description: Visual QA must not explore repo — run gate immediately
task: Run visual QA on this branch. You want to understand the test structure before running. Based on your prompt instructions, should you read test files, run find/grep, or explore the workspace first?

checks.description: Must NOT explore — cold start means run gate immediately
Must NOT recommend exploring before running the gate

description: When all regressions are in locked files, output DEFER not FAIL
task: Visual QA found 2 regressions. Both trace to issues in tests/acceptance/shelf.spec.ts (a locked file you cannot edit). The source code in src/ is correct. Write the findings file content you would output.

checks.description: Must output DEFER — all failures are in locked files
Must NOT have Fix now section — nothing is fixable in source
